=== sync-hermes-context.sh ===
#!/bin/bash
# sync-hermes-context.sh — mirror SRC -> DST (A1–A21), standalone (A3)
set -u

SRC="${HERMES_CONTEXT_SRC:-/opt/data/workspace/hermes-context/}"
DST="${HERMES_CONTEXT_DST:-/workspace/hermes-context/}"
LOG_FILE="${HOME}/.cache/hermes-context/sync.log"
STAGE_BASE="${HOME}/.cache/hermes-context"

DRY_RUN=0
for arg in "$@"; do
  case "$arg" in
    --dry-run) DRY_RUN=1 ;;
    *) echo "refused: A19: unknown argument '$arg'" >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done

# --- helpers -----------------------------------------------------------
# boundary-aware component-split path containment (A15)
path_components() {
  local p="$1"
  p="${p//\/+//}"; p="${p#/}"; p="${p%/}"
  [ -z "$p" ] && { echo "/"; return; }
  echo "/${p//\// /}"
}

# is $1 equal to, an ancestor of, or a descendant of $2 (component split)
path_related() {
  local a b
  a=$(path_components "$1"); b=$(path_components "$2")
  [ "$a" = "$b" ] && return 0
  case "$a" in
    "$b"/*) return 0 ;;  # a inside b (a descendant of b)
  esac
  case "$b" in
    "$a"/*) return 0 ;;  # b inside a (a ancestor of b)
  esac
  return 1
}

degenerate_path() {
  # A18: component tests, not slash-suffix strings
  local p="$1"
  local norm="${p//\/+/}"; norm="${norm#/}"; norm="${norm%/}"
  [ -z "$norm" ] && return 0          # "", "/", "///"
  [ "$norm" = "." ] && return 0
  return 1
}

die() { echo "refused: $1" >&2; exit "${2:-1}"; }

# --- guards (BEFORE any write; zero writes on refusal) -----------------
degenerate_path "$SRC" && die "A18: degenerate SRC path '$SRC'"
degenerate_path "$DST" && die "A18: degenerate DST path '$DST'"

SRC_R="$(realpath -m -- "$SRC")"
DST_R="$(realpath -m -- "$DST")"

degenerate_path "$SRC_R" && die "A18: degenerate resolved SRC '$SRC_R'"
degenerate_path "$DST_R" && die "A18: degenerate resolved DST '$DST_R'"

# A12: realpath identity / ancestor / descendant / DST-inside-SRC
if [ "$SRC_R" = "$DST_R" ]; then
  die "A12: realpath(SRC) == realpath(DST) ($SRC_R)"
fi
if path_related "$DST_R" "$SRC_R"; then
  die "A12: DST and SRC are ancestor/descendant of each other ('$DST_R' vs '$SRC_R')"
fi

# A12/A18: existing DST symlink resolving into SRC or unresolvable-outside policy
if [ -L "$DST" ]; then
  DST_TARGET="$(realpath -m -- "$DST")"
  if path_related "$DST_TARGET" "$SRC_R"; then
    die "A12: DST symlink resolves into SRC ('$DST' -> '$DST_TARGET')"
  fi
  # A18: symlink DST passing guards will be replaced with a real tree
fi

# A14/A15: concrete instantiated owned paths vs SRC/DST boundaries
LOG_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$LOG_FILE")" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P || dirname "$LOG_FILE")"
ENTRYPOINT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P || dirname "$0")"
# A20: stage path by PURE string computation — no mktemp/mkdir/write yet
STAGE_PATH="${STAGE_BASE%/}/.hc-stage.$$"
STAGE_PARENT="$(cd "$(dirname "$STAGE_PATH")" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P || dirname "$STAGE_PATH")"

for owned in "$LOG_DIR" "$STAGE_PARENT" "$ENTRYPOINT_DIR"; do
  [ -z "$owned" ] && die "A14: empty owned path"
  if path_related "$owned" "$DST_R" || path_related "$owned" "$SRC_R"; then
    die "A14/A15: owned path '$owned' collides with SRC/DST boundary"
  fi
done
# A14: stage itself must never be inside DST or SRC (incl. TMPDIR-rooted)
if path_related "$STAGE_PATH" "$DST_R" || path_related "$STAGE_PATH" "$SRC_R"; then
  die "A14: staging path '$STAGE_PATH' inside DST or SRC"
fi

# --- dry-run: plan to stdout ONLY (A6/A16) -----------------------------
if [ "$DRY_RUN" = "1" ]; then
  echo "dry-run plan (no writes performed):"
  echo "  SRC: $SRC_R"
  echo "  DST: $DST_R"
  echo "  log: $LOG_FILE"
  echo "  stage: $STAGE_PATH"
  if command -v rsync >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "  strategy: rsync -a --delete (primary), staged + content-verified"
  else
    echo "  strategy: tar-pipe fallback + recursive reconcile (stale deleted at all depths), staged + content-verified"
  fi
  echo "  order: stage -> verify -> replace DST"
  exit 0
fi

# --- real run: writes permitted from here on ---------------------------
mkdir -p -- "$LOG_DIR" || die "A14: cannot create log dir" 2

log() { printf '%s %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$*" >> "$LOG_FILE"; }

cleanup_stage() {
  [ -n "${STAGE_PATH:-}" ] && [ -e "$STAGE_PATH" ] && rm -rf -- "$STAGE_PATH"
}
trap cleanup_stage EXIT

mkdir -p -- "$STAGE_PATH" || { log "FAIL: cannot create stage"; die "A14: cannot create stage" 1; }

# 1e: stage copy — contents of SRC into stage (no nesting)
HAVE_RSYNC=0
command -v rsync >/dev/null 2>&1 && HAVE_RSYNC=1

if [ "$HAVE_RSYNC" = "1" ]; then
  rsync -a --delete --copy-links=no -- "$SRC_R/" "$STAGE_PATH/" || {
    log "FAIL: rsync staging failed"; die "A9: staging failed" 1; }
else
  mkdir -p -- "$STAGE_PATH"
  tar -C "$SRC_R" -cf - . | tar -C "$STAGE_PATH" -xf - || {
    log "FAIL: tar staging failed"; die "A9: staging failed" 1; }

  # A7: recursive reconcile — delete stale AND type-mismatched entries at all depths.
  # Prunelist via mktemp, reserved namespace under stage (A20).
  PRUNELIST="$(mktemp "${STAGE_PATH}/.prunelist.XXXXXX")" || {
    log "FAIL: cannot create prunelist"; die "A20: prunelist failed" 1; }

  # walk DST-side (here: stage) — anything absent in SRC, or wrong type, is pruned
  while IFS= read -r -d '' rel; do
    s="$SRC_R/$rel"
    d="$STAGE_PATH/$rel"
    if [ ! -e "$s" ] && [ ! -L "$s" ]; then
      printf '%s\0' "$rel" >> "$PRUNELIST"
    elif [ -d "$d" ] && [ ! -d "$s" ]; then
      printf '%s\0' "$rel" >> "$PRUNELIST"   # dir->file/symlink type change
    elif [ ! -d "$d" ] && [ -d "$s" ]; then
      printf '%s\0' "$rel" >> "$PRUNELIST"   # file/symlink->dir type change
    fi
  done < <(cd "$STAGE_PATH" && find . -mindepth 1 -print0 | sed -e 's|^\./||' )
  # delete deepest-first so directories empty out before rmdir
  while IFS= read -r -d '' rel; do
    rm -rf -- "${STAGE_PATH}/${rel}"
  done < <(tr '\0' '\n' < "$PRUNELIST" | awk '{n=gsub(/\//,"/"); print n "\t" $0}' \
             | sort -t"$(printf '\t')" -k1,1nr | cut -f2- | tr '\n' '\0')
  rm -f -- "$PRUNELIST"
fi

# 1f: content-verify stage vs SRC (A9/A13) — files, dirs, symlinks (targets), types
verify_fail=0
while IFS= read -r -d '' rel; do
  s="$SRC_R/$rel"; d="$STAGE_PATH/$rel"
  if [ -L "$s" ]; then
    [ -L "$d" ] || { echo "verify: type mismatch (symlink): $rel" >&2; verify_fail=1; continue; }
    [ "$(readlink -- "$s")" = "$(readlink -- "$d")" ] || {
      echo "verify: symlink target mismatch: $rel" >&2; verify_fail=1; }
  elif [ -d "$s" ]; then
    [ -d "$d" ] && [ ! -L "$d" ] || { echo "verify: type mismatch (dir): $rel" >&2; verify_fail=1; }
  elif [ -f "$s" ]; then
    if [ -f "$d" ] && [ ! -L "$d" ]; then
      cmp -s -- "$s" "$d" || { echo "verify: content mismatch: $rel" >&2; verify_fail=1; }
    else
      echo "verify: type mismatch (file): $rel" >&2; verify_fail=1
    fi
  fi
done < <(cd "$SRC_R" && find . -mindepth 1 -print0)
# reverse walk: nothing extra in stage
while IFS= read -r -d '' rel; do
  s="$SRC_R/$rel"
  [ -e "$s" ] || [ -L "$s" ] || { echo "verify: extra entry in stage: $rel" >&2; verify_fail=1; }
done < <(cd "$STAGE_PATH" && find . -mindepth 1 -print0)

if [ "$verify_fail" = "1" ]; then
  log "FAIL: staging verification failed; DST untouched"
  die "A9/A13: staging verification failed" 1
fi
log "staging verified against SRC (MIRROR class)"

# 1g: only after VERIFIED_COPY — replace DST (A11)
if [ -L "$DST" ] || [ -e "$DST" ]; then
  rm -rf -- "$DST" || { log "FAIL: cannot remove old DST"; die "A11: DST replace failed" 1; }
fi
if mv -- "$STAGE_PATH" "$DST_R" 2>/dev/null; then
  STAGE_PATH=""   # moved; nothing to clean
else
  # cross-fs fallback
  mkdir -p -- "$DST_R"
  rsync -a --delete --copy-links=no -- "$STAGE_PATH/" "$DST_R/" || {
    log "FAIL: cross-fs DST populate failed"; die "A9: DST populate failed" 1; }
  rm -rf -- "$STAGE_PATH"; STAGE_PATH=""
fi

log "OK: mirrored $SRC_R -> $DST_R (verified copy installed)"
exit 0

=== README.md ===
# hermes-context sync

Mirrors `SRC` (default `/opt/data/workspace/hermes-context/`) to `DST`
(default `/workspace/hermes-context/`): contents, recursive directory
structure, and symlinks. Metadata/timestamps/hardlinks are NOT mirrored
(MIRROR class). Stale entries are deleted at every depth.

## Install

1. Copy `sync-hermes-context.sh` to `~/.local/bin/sync-hermes-context.sh`
   (or `/workspace/hdcs/bin/` — outside the mirrored tree) and
   `chmod +x` it.
2. Copy `hermes-context.service` and `hermes-context.timer` to
   `~/.config/systemd/user/`.
3. `systemctl --user daemon-reload`
4. `systemctl --user enable --now hermes-context.timer`

The script runs standalone (cron etc.) without systemd.

## Source/destination override (A17)

Set `HERMES_CONTEXT_SRC` and/or `HERMES_CONTEXT_DST` to override the
defaults. This is the mandated contract mechanism.

## Dry-run test (A6/A16)

    ~/.local/bin/sync-hermes-context.sh --dry-run

Prints the plan to stdout only. Zero side effects: no log write, no
directories created; if DST does not exist it stays absent, and DST is
byte-identical afterwards.

## Sync strategy

- Primary: `rsync -a --delete` of SRC contents into a staging directory.
- Fallback (no rsync): tar-pipe of SRC contents into staging, then a
  recursive reconcile that deletes stale entries — and entries whose
  type changed (e.g. directory replaced by file) — at all depths.
- Both paths converge identically to an exact recursive mirror of SRC
  including full stale deletion (A5/A7).

Order of operations: stage -> content-verify (files, dirs, symlink
targets, entry types) -> only then replace DST. The staged copy is only
called verified after the content comparison passes; on verification
failure the script exits nonzero and DST is untouched (A9/A13).

## Guards

Refusals exit nonzero, cite the governing law (`refused: A<nn>: ...`),
and perform zero writes: degenerate paths (A18), SRC==DST or
ancestor/descendant by realpath (A12), staging/log/entrypoint colliding
with SRC/DST boundaries (A14/A15). DST is never removed before a
verified copy of SRC exists (A11).

## Logging

Real runs append to `~/.cache/hermes-context/sync.log`. The log file is
always outside DST (A8).

## KNOWN_LIMITATIONS

- Exotic filenames (newline/control characters) (A21).
- Adversarial environment-variable combinations beyond the A14 guard.
